string.value: By the way, is your vehicle fully airtight? No? Great… I mean, bad.
The thing is, if the soldiers already broke the Z-120 container, you have no more than half an hour before the toxin inducts DNA-reductase replication and… well, nevermind.
I mean, in half an hour the toxin will either kill you, or turn you into an ugly monster, yes it will!
All right. There's a swamp. Almost everywhere. In some places it's more swampy, in some places less. Like, where you see the path, it is.
A usual thing about these swamps, yes it is. I read tons on that.
The case with my papers must be seen somewhere, yes it does. If they didn't sink it, of course. Oh, they can. I mean the bandits. And the soldiers.
So, ask both groups. Somebody must know for sure.
So, did you find the place? What do the soldiers say? What do you mean, all dead?! Well, great!
Ahem, I'm being sarcastic, yes, speaking sarcastically. I mean, what a pity, right!
But anyway, get my materials! I believe you can, yes I do. Just look thoroughly.
Attention, agent, answer if you hear me! Copy? Copy? Team Delta commander contacted us.
His guys tried to destroy the trucks with this damn Z-120 with termite charges, but the attempt failed.
Hundreds of monster literally crushed them. The team was able to burn a single truck, and it took lives of all soldiers.
Find the unused charges and burn the trucks with these damn containers.
Now you have the termite charges. The temperature they create will leave any chemical, biological or whatever infection no more chances to survive then a snowman has in hell.
For God's sake, in the name of our dead boys, finish the job they started. Burn these damn containers!
We've adjusted the existing data. You will have to burn two trucks with Z-120 containers.
Also try to find and retrieve the alien specimens and materials of professor Pappers.
It seems that burning the trucks will be only a half of the job. Hordes of monsters swarming all around are going to be the real problem.
It looks like a camp of people who hid from the evacuation in the swamp.
When the infection from containers affected them, they became the monsters killing everyone who isn't like them.
Besides the truck with Z-120, you must destroy all monsters found nearby.
So, you handled it perfectly, as usual. I hope the world is preserved from mass mutation now.
Your job is nearly done, but professor Pappers makes things difficult by not wanting to return without his papers.
I have no idea where his works could be! Well, I do have a clue, however.
The commander of team Delta reported about his group being dead, but it's still unclear what happened to him.
Perhaps if you find him, you'll find the records of Pappers
